root_cause.text: The error handling path in `pvrdma_alloc_ucontext()` explicitly calls `pvrdma_uar_free()` to release the User Access Region (UAR) resource, which is already freed internally by the subsequent call to `pvrdma_dealloc_ucontext()`, resulting in a double free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the removal of `pvrdma_uar_free(vdev, &context->uar)` from the error path of `pvrdma_alloc_ucontext()` when `ib_copy_to_udata()` fails, accompanied by the comment "pvrdma_dealloc_ucontext() also frees the UAR".

bic_trace_step.reason: In pvrdma_alloc_ucontext(), if ib_copy_to_udata() fails (line 360), the code calls pvrdma_uar_free(vdev, &context->uar) on line 361, and then calls pvrdma_dealloc_ucontext(&context->ibucontext) on line 363. However, pvrdma_dealloc_ucontext() also calls pvrdma_uar_free(to_vdev(ibcontext->device), &context->uar) on line 393, leading to a double free of the UAR resource.
